answer: The lagoon counter is kept in kernel and fable shows each threshold crossing. An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 10 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that pays. That bill is paid per identity, so 266 aliases cost 51 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
